Rae (Marketing): Quick notice 1: planning to publish performance brief + reproducibility notes Tues 09:00 PT (embargoed). Need spokes + assets. Pre-brief 08:20 PT. Who's in?
Jordan (PR): 09:00 PT works. I'll run press outreach and briefing calls. Can Pri join pre-brief?
Pri (CEO): I can do 08:20-08:35 PT. Short remarks only.
Lena (Eng): Will upload perf PNGs (1200x600), CSVs, and the run commands by EOD Mon. Also include hardware table.
Hugo (Legal): Heads-up: avoid superlatives like "industry-leading" unless tied to a specific benchmark. Send embargo text for sign-off.
Rae (Marketing): Noted. Drafting 1-pager and two quote options. Mina, can you prep social lengths?
Mina (Comms): Yes 1. Two versions: short and long. Also prepping internal FAQ for CS.
Sam (Sales): I'll handle any enterprise media callbacks 09:30-10:30 PT. Route customer questions to me.
Jordan (PR): Call schedule: Pri 09:00-09:20, Lena 09:00-09:40, Sam 09:30-10:30. I'll send invites when assets land.
notif-bot: Publish job queued for 2076543210. Reminder set. :robot_face: 
Rae (Marketing): Ops note for eng-oncall: expect a traffic bump first 5-10 min. Route to canary; fallback to baseline if P95 > 600ms.
Lena (Eng): I'll add a temporary perf alert and rollback playbook. Run snippet for reproducibility: ```bash
./bench --model=rwd-v3 --seq=1024 --runs=3
```
Hugo (Legal): Embargo language cleared with edits. Rae please send final paragraph for sign-off.
Mina (Comms): Internal post ready to go to #announcements at publish time and I'll ping Support + Sales.
Rae (Marketing): Final checklist: 1) Blog + assets by EOD Mon; 2) Embargo text signed; 3) Press pack + invites; 4) 08:20 PT pre-brief; 5) Phone standby 09:00-10:30 PT.
Jordan (PR): Reminder: no screenshots or early excerpts to press. If contacted early, route to me.
Pri (CEO): Thanks everyone. Keep pre-brief to 10 minutes.
Rae (Marketing): Will post when files are uploaded. :rocket:
